name: Media phosphor terminal
doc: Renders the input photo, video or camera as a live phosphor terminal in ASCII, sub-sampled 2x4 Braille, hex telemetry or ANSI shade blocks, locking directional wireframe glyphs onto subject edges with a beat-synced scan beam and onset line glitches.

luma.doc: optional brightness mask (core-media.luma); falls back to source luma

edges.doc: optional edge gradient field (core-media.edges); falls back to source Sobel

palette.doc: phosphor color ramp blended with the source media

charset.doc: glyph set: ASCII ramp, 2x4 sub-sampled Braille, hex telemetry, or ANSI shade blocks

cell.doc: character cell height in pixels at 1080p

color_mix.doc: 0 = pure phosphor palette, 1 = source media color

edge_lock.doc: directional wireframe glyph lock along subject edges

scan_beam.doc: beat-locked CRT phosphor raster sweep intensity

glitch.doc: onset horizontal line tear, byte scramble and RGB convergence split
